entries.title: John 9:1
segments: As Jesus passed by, he saw a man who had been blind from his birth.

entries.title: John 9:2
segments: "Rabbi," asked his disciples, "who was it that sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?"

entries.title: John 9:3
segments: "Neither the man nor the parents," replied Jesus; "but he was born blind that the work of God should be made plain in him.

entries.title: John 9:4
segments: We must do the work of him who sent me, while it is day; night is coming, when no one can work.

entries.title: John 9:5
segments: As long as I am in the world, I am the Light of the world."

entries.title: John 9:6
segments: Saying this, Jesus spat on the ground, made clay with the saliva, and put it on the man's eyes.

entries.title: John 9:7
segments: "Go," he said, "and wash your eyes in the Bath of Siloam" (a word which means 'Messenger'). So the man went and washed his eyes, and returned able to see.

entries.title: John 9:8
segments: Upon this his neighbors, and those who had formerly known him by sight as a beggar, exclaimed: "Is not this the man who used to sit and beg?"

entries.title: John 9:9
segments: "Yes," some said, "it is"; while others said: "No, but he is like him." The man himself said: "I am he."

entries.title: John 9:10
segments: "How did you get your sight, then?" they asked.

entries.title: John 9:11
segments: "The man whom they call Jesus," he answered, "made clay, and anointed my eyes, and said to me 'Go to Siloam and wash your eyes.' So I went and washed my eyes, and gained my sight."

entries.title: John 9:12
segments: "Where is he?" they asked. I do not know," he answered.

entries.title: John 9:13
segments: They took the man, who had been blind, to the Pharisees.

entries.title: John 9:14
segments: Now it was a Sabbath when Jesus made the clay and gave him his sight.

entries.title: John 9:15
segments: So the Pharisees also questioned the man as to how he had gained his sight. "He put clay on my eyes," he answered, "and I washed them, and I can see."

entries.title: John 9:16
segments: "The man cannot be from God," said some of the Pharisees, "for he does not keep the Sabbath." "How is it possible," retorted others, "for a bad man to give signs like this?"

entries.title: John 9:17
segments: So there was a difference of opinion among them, and they again questioned the man; "What do you yourself say about him, for it is to you that he has given sight?"

entries.title: John 9:18
segments: The Jews, however, refused to believe that he had been blind and had gained his sight, until they had called his parents and questioned them.

entries.title: John 9:19
segments: "Is this your son," they asked, "who you say was born blind? If so, how is it that he can see now?"

entries.title: John 9:20
segments: "We know that this is our son," answered the parents, "and that he was born blind;

entries.title: John 9:21
segments: But how it is that he can see now we do not know; nor do we know who it was that gave him his sight. Ask him--he is old enough- -he will tell you about himself."

entries.title: John 9:22
segments: His parents spoke in this way because they were afraid of the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that, if any one should acknowledge Jesus as the Christ, he should be expelled from their synagogues.

entries.title: John 9:23
segments: This was why his parents said 'He is old enough; ask him.'

entries.title: John 9:24
segments: So the Jews again called the man who had been blind, and said to him: "Give God the praise; we know that this is a bad man."

entries.title: John 9:25
segments: "I know nothing about his being a bad man," he replied; "one thing I do know, that although I was blind, now I can see."

entries.title: John 9:26
segments: "What did he do to you?" they asked. "How did he give you your sight?"

entries.title: John 9:27
segments: "I told you just now," he answered, "and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Surely you also do not want to become his disciples?"

entries.title: John 9:28
segments: "You are his disciple," they retorted scornfully; "but we are disciples of Moses.

entries.title: John 9:29
segments: We know that God spoke to Moses; but, as for this man, we do not know where he comes from."

entries.title: John 9:30
segments: "Well," the man replied, "this is very strange; you do not know where he comes from, and yet he has given me my sight!

entries.title: John 9:31
segments: We know that God never listens to bad men, but, when a man is god-fearing and does God's will, God listens to him.

entries.title: John 9:32
segments: Since the world began, such a thing was never heard of as any one's giving sight to a person born blind.

entries.title: John 9:33
segments: If this man had not been from God, he could not have done anything at all."

entries.title: John 9:34
segments: "You," they retorted, "were born totally depraved; and are you trying to teach us?" So they expelled him.

entries.title: John 9:35
segments: Jesus heard of their having put him out; and, when he had found the man, he asked: "Do you believe in the Son of Man?"

entries.title: John 9:36
segments: "Tell me who he is, Sir," he replied, "so that I may believe in him."

entries.title: John 9:37
segments: "Not only have you seen him," said Jesus; "but it is he who is now speaking to you."

entries.title: John 9:38
segments: "Then, Sir, I do believe," said the man, bowing to the ground before him;

entries.title: John 9:39
segments: And Jesus added: "It was to put men to the test that I came into this world, in order that those that cannot see should see, and that those that can see should become blind."

entries.title: John 9:40
segments: Hearing this, some of the Pharisees who were with him said: "Then are we blind too?"

entries.title: John 9:41
segments: "If you had been blind," replied Jesus, "you would have had no sin to answer for; but, as it is, you say 'We can see,' and so your sin remains.
